findings.oracle: Replaced the 80 construction-only smoke tests with 33 behavioral gates: SectionInfo r/w/x decoding checked against the independent PE/COFF IMAGE_SCN_* bit spec (incl. a real System32 kernel32.dll parsed by the real HexEditorBridge into SectionInfo whose .text decodes executable); DataTypeInfo.display_type / FunctionInfo.summary / ToolFunction.signature / CrossReference,BreakpointInfo,ThreadInfo __str__ asserted against hand-derived exact strings; RegisterState __getitem__/get_gpr_dict/get_segment_registers incl. the KeyError error path; the exception hierarchy's structured context through real raise/except; and real-SQLite SessionStore round-trips for PatchInfo bytes, Message+ToolCall, ToolState enum keys, BridgeAnalysisSummary, and a real-PE BinaryInfo with an independently computed SHA-256. Each asserts exact values/structure and goes red if the corresponding property, mask, serialiser, or bridge walk is corrupted.
